review_method: Root assistant and independent read-only visual reviewer inspected actual final-02 native rendered images; no generated imagery.

observations: Distant phase seam is visibly smoother than final-01; ground reaches the distant tree line without exposed edge or sky-sphere cutoff.
Original near-ground large texture scale and a local phase boundary remain source-retained.
No new normal inversion, dark patch, hard shading band or overall exposure change was observed.
Brick color variation, mortar joints and coping remain legible in tree shade.
Wall base meets ground; wall end clears paved path; no visible tree-trunk intersection.
Long wall has continuous brick detail and a clear coping silhouette.
Wall base is grounded and entrance-side paved route remains open.
Open entrance and both wall ends remain visible; exterior tree trunks, leaves and sky are clear.
Source floor tiles, door frames and cream wall columns retain material detail across interior and exterior exposure.
Field markings, raised platform, trusses, stair and columns remain legible.
High-window foliage, sky and clouds are clear; no new interior material or exposure issue was observed.

source_retained_observations: Original grass has bright green coloring, large texture scale and locally visible near-ground joins. This acceptance does not claim removal of all source-ground joins.
